title: Certify, Then Select: Viability-Aware Runtime Steering of Frozen Diffusion Policies
abstract: arXiv:2611.19047v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Diffusion policies, which generate short action sequences by denoising random noise, are a leading way to learn robot skills from demonstrations. Once deployed, they meet constraints the demonstrations never contained, and retraining for each is impractical. A safety filter edits the policy's action to satisfy them, but the edit ignores the task, and a large edit can leave the policy where it cannot continue. We propose CAST (Certified Action Selection at Test time): draw a few action chunks from the frozen policy, certify each with a barrier condition, and execute the certified chunk that a learned value ensemble ranks highest. We prove that a certified step is safe whatever the critic does; that, whenever a certified sample exists, the executed chunk stays within log N nats of the policy conditioned on feasibility, while a safety-filter projection can be singular to it; and that an exact closed-loop identity splits the gain of rankin

translated_title: 先认证，后选择：冻结扩散策略的可行性感知运行时引导
translated_abstract: 扩散策略通过去噪随机噪声来生成短动作序列，是从演示中学习机器人技能的主流方法。然而一旦部署，策略会遇到演示数据中从未包含过的约束，而针对每种约束重新训练并不现实。安全过滤器通过修改策略动作来满足约束，但这种修改忽略了任务本身，且较大的修改可能使策略陷入无法继续完成任务的状态。我们提出CAST（测试时认证动作选择）：从冻结策略中抽取少量动作块，用屏障条件逐一认证，然后执行由学习到的价值集成模型排名最高的已认证动作块。我们证明：无论评论家网络表现如何，已认证的步骤都是安全的；只要存在已认证的样本，执行的动作块在以可行性为条件时与原策略的差异保持在 log N nat 以内，而安全过滤器的投影甚至可能与原策略分布奇异（完全不相交）；此外，一个精确的闭环恒等式将排序带来的收益分解为可解释的组成部分……
tldr: 提出CAST方法：在测试时从冻结扩散策略中采样少量动作块、用屏障条件认证其安全性，再由学习到的价值集成选出最优者执行，从而在不重训策略的前提下以理论保证实现兼顾安全与任务可行性的运行时引导。
en_tdlr: CAST steers frozen diffusion policies at runtime by sampling a few action chunks, certifying each with a barrier condition, and executing the certified chunk ranked highest by a learned value ensemble, with provable guarantees on safety, distributional closeness to the policy, and an exact decomposition of ranking gains.
